risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be damaged, incomplete, or seized).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling risk: engine assembly may have hidden cracks or leaks not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the engine block, oil pan, coolant passages, and any wet/oily areas; plus a leak test report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential hidden issues (worst-case: leaks/damage).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/part number plate or stamped code (engine block and gearbox).
Send the vehicle details it came from (make/model/year) and the engine/gearbox codes.
Provide a short video showing the engine running (or at least a test/compression/leak-down report).
Confirm completeness: list what is included (ECU, starter, alternator, turbo/supercharger if any, sensors, wiring harness, intake/exhaust manifolds).
Send close-ups of any visible damage and the oil pan/coolant/oil ports.
